package.name: mobile_manipulator_arm_control
package.description:
MoveIt2 integration for mobile manipulator arm.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES: - Understand MoveIt2 configuration (SRDF, kinematics, joint limits) - See MoveGroupInterface usage patterns - Learn planning group and end effector concepts - Practice named poses and trajectory execution
KEY FILES: - config/mobile_manipulator.srdf: Semantic robot description - config/kinematics.yaml: IK solver configuration - config/joint_limits.yaml: Motion limits for planning - scripts/arm_interface.py: Python wrapper for MoveIt
